decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel builds directly on the firm's core authentication and cryptography know-how and fits its stated direction toward binding mobile communication, so the firm's own R&D can interpret results and refine it.

The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture was promoted to its own page in 2019 and expresses the firm's core cryptographic competence, so strong related knowledge supports learning from it and keeping it.

The QR-based hardware signature token sits close to the established authentication hardware offer and gained its own page in 2019, so the firm has the knowledge to refine it despite some hardware market risk.

The payment security compliance suite builds on the firm's transaction-authorization expertise and serves regulated customers, although it was only ever mentioned rather than featured, which leaves a moderate risk of being folded into other offers.
